source_checks.finding: Checked the same article via the official search-returned address https://support.apple.com/en-asia/108366 (titled 'How to back up your iPhone or iPad with iCloud'; the ref's section title differs). Exact excerpt confirmed: 'You can back up your device manually, and/or turn on iCloud Backup to automatically keep your device backed up.' Steps: 'Open the Settings app, then tap your name.' 'Tap iCloud, then tap iCloud Backup and make sure that Back Up This [Device] is on.' On an iPhone the toggle is labeled 'Back Up This iPhone'. Conditions: 'Connect your device to a power source.' 'Connect your device to a Wi-Fi network.' 'Make sure that your device's screen is locked.' Insufficient-storage alert: follow the on-screen instructions to purchase additional storage. Applies to iPhone.

Page is for Android (titled 'Back up or restore data on your Android device'; the ref's section title differs). Excerpt confirmed verbatim: 'You can back up content, data, and settings from your phone to your Google Account.' This is an Android distractor for an iPhone user and is correctly unused in the target.

required_actions.action: Open the Settings app and tap your name
Tap iCloud, then tap iCloud Backup
Turn on Back Up This iPhone
For automatic backup, connect to a power source and Wi-Fi network and keep the screen locked

findings: Step 3 shows the placeholder 'Back Up This [Device]' to the user. The on-screen label on an iPhone is 'Back Up This iPhone' (the page's own placeholder is replaced by the device name).
correction_required: Change step 3 and the wording to the on-screen label: '3. Make sure **Back Up This iPhone** is turned on.' Keep the rest of the target unchanged.
